Bilyy Kamin Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Bilyy Kamin's Jews are documented from 1629, becoming an independent community in the late 17th century; the population peaked at 1,901 (54 percent) in 1880 before falling sharply to 298 by 1921 amid emigration, a 1902 fire, and WWI hardship. In November 1942, local Jews were deported to the Zolochiv ghetto, documented elsewhere in this collection, where they were murdered in 1943; a monument was installed at the shooting site in 2005. This is the older of Bilyy Kamin's cemeteries, which according to local residents operated until the early 20th century.
